description: Diagnostic daemon to investigate why mcp_server_registry (?), mcp_signal_scores (?), and mcp_fingerprints (?) show MISSING TABLE or ? in core table counts. Must query information_schema.columns to verify actual table existence vs row counts. Report findings as JSON to write_service service_health meta field. Must NOT propose any rebuilds - this is diagnostic only. Target: understand whether tables exist but are empty, or whether schema bootstrap failed.
